metadata.title: LinguaRoom — language lessons
metadata.description: A platform for language tutors: lessons, homework, vocabulary and a word trainer.

landing.tagline: Language lessons made simple, without extra buttons
landing.description: Manage students, run live lessons, set self-checking homework and practise words in the trainer.
landing.featureLessonsText: The lesson opens for you and your student at the same time, and you see answers instantly.
landing.featureHomeworkText: Students see their mistakes right away, and you see how they did.
landing.featureVocabularyText: Words from the lesson go straight into spaced repetition.
